body.name: Zero-allowed latent feedback class \(\mathfrak M^{\le}_{\mathcal I}(G)\)
body.construction:
The zero-allowed mechanism class is
\[
\mathfrak M^{\le}_{\mathcal I}(G)=\left\{(B,(P_{\varepsilon_i})_{i\in V}):\operatorname{supp}(B)\subseteq E(G),\ B_{ii}=0,\ \det(Q_{V\setminus S,V\setminus S})\ne0\ \forall S\in\mathcal I,
\right.\]
\[
\left.(P_{\varepsilon_i})_{i\in V}\text{ are mutually independent, nonconstant, and non-Gaussian, and interventions are surgical}\right\}.
\]
